gen-gf-goldman-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Wide, loud, and sure of itself: Goldman spreads out with round, parenthesis-like forms. Holtwood One SC answers with a towering text serif whose curves nearly close, giving the page a heavy, literary weight.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-manuale: Goldman's round, parenthesis-shaped forms spread wide with plenty of clearance up top. Manuale takes over below, a traditional editorial serif with large-eyed lowercase and a faint thick-thin shift that keeps a long page easy on the eyes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-naskh-arabic: Noto Naskh Arabic is refined and classic, with a very tall x-height and modest contrast like lightly engraved brass. Noto Naskh Arabic quietly carries the text, while Goldman's wide, bold display letters take the commanding front seat.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu: Goldman sets its wide, bold letters with generous clearance, a big lowercase rising against the capitals, while Noto Nastaliq Urdu follows below. Its text serif rhythm is tight and dignified.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew: Noto Rashi Hebrew reads classic and bookish, with short ascender stems and a modest contrast like lightly engraved brass lettering. Goldman's wide, commanding forms then stand over it, loud against its gentle weight changes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Noto Serif Ahom stands lofty and dignified, with tapering joins. Its strongest quality alongside Goldman is the stately pull between wide, bold display forms and a measured, traditional serif that rises tall beneath them.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-armenian: Loud on top, gentle below. Goldman is wide and commanding with round, open forms, while Noto Serif Armenian, a classic serif with big open counters and a mild stroke contrast, does the patient, authoritative work of carrying text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-balinese: Commanding up top, then editorial below. Goldman's wide, round letters bring the swagger, while Noto Serif Balinese brings lowercase with great vertical presence, and that tall, traditional classic serif is what gives the pair its backbone.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-bengali: Noto Serif Bengali reads refined and editorial, a text serif with slightly thinner hairlines and trimmed-looking ascenders in a dense band of letters. And Goldman sits over it, wide and bold, its round forms loosening the whole arrangement.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-devanagari: Literary in feel, Noto Serif Devanagari is a classic serif with short ascenders, a big lowercase and slightly thinner curves at the tops of its rounds. Its strongest quality beside Goldman is stone-carved weight.
